notes:
New Features:

- 1 h and 2 h long checks now run five minutes longer internally, resulting in 65-minute and 125-minute hold windows while 15-minute and 30-minute checks remain unchanged.
- 1 h and 2 h checks now offer a Save Log Only end action alongside PC Sleep and Shutdown + Copy Log.

Improvements:

- Dorcel TV now uses a 10-second InputStream Adaptive live delay to provide additional segment reserve against Kodi-only mini-buffering while keeping the website-originated periodic freezes unchanged.
- Dorcel diagnostics now classify observed stalls as source_likely, kodi_buffer_likely, shared_or_kodi_ambiguous or healthy and log sequence deltas for easier comparison with Web Video Caster/browser behaviour.

Bugfixes:

- Removes the old Dorcel startup-quality recovery reopen that could trigger an unnecessary Kodi-only restart shortly after playback began.
- Removes Dorcel-specific HLS media/discontinuity sequence repair options that were no longer useful once the recurring large freezes were confirmed to occur identically on the website.

Important:

- The existing long-check runtime state, check lock, AlarmClock, watchdog, log-copy and shutdown safety logic remain unchanged apart from the requested +5-minute hold duration and new Save Log Only end action.
